signup.title: Save your progress
signup.lead: Your week map and progress move with you. Use the same email to open them on any device.

login.title: Log in
login.lead: Open your week map, plan and points.

gate.title: Create an account to continue
gate.lead: A plan belongs to an account, so you can open it on any device. Your week map and progress move with you.

errors.invalid_login: That email and password don't match an account. Check them and try again.
errors.email_taken: This email already has an account. Log in with it instead.
errors.account_exists: This profile already has an account. Log in to open it.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again. What you typed is still here.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a minute. What you typed is still here.

demoNote: Your own copy of a demo account. Log out any time.
